Publish the plugin in the current directory as a new version

Usage: hpy registry plugin publish [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json                    Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --wasm <WASM>             Path to the built .wasm module, relative to the plugin's directory
                                (-C)
      --no-input                Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions
                                still need --yes. Implied without a terminal
      --version <VERSION>       Version to publish (default: manifest.json version)
  -C <DIR>                      Run as if started in DIR
      --track <TRACK>           The channel to move to this version: latest, beta or alpha (default:
                                latest for a stable version, else the prerelease's name)
      --promote <FROM_VERSION>  Publish an already published version's artifact as --version instead
                                of building one
      --dry-run                 Validate and print what would be published without publishing
      --no-build                Skip hpy.toml [build] command
      --wait                    Wait until the registry has copied the version's blobs
  -y, --yes                     Do not ask for confirmation
  -h, --help                    Print help
